column1: # json-read-closed). One small unit — `Closed` (a flags field, an enum, a
# union, a map keyed by string, a string field) and `Scene` (a pointer, for the
# `&` name's site) — read by the engine and every port card.
#   (1) a schema-name string — an object key naming a field, an enum variant
#       name, a flags element, a union arm key, a pointer's first key (the
#       `&node` name's site) — is capped at 255 bytes and a longer one refuses;
#       a map key and a string value are data, never capped for length.
#   (2) the depth cap, 128, counts every container (object and array), the
#       root at depth 0, in a skipped value too.
#   (3) a lone surrogate and an ill-formed UTF-8 byte in a string value refuse.
# Columns, tab-separated: name, root, json file, verdict, what it holds.
